title: Parameter-free derivation chain and the factor of $1/2$
html:
The pairwise Hopf-link estimate of the cyclisation barrier overshot by a factor of two. The threading-link picture halves it exactly, with no free parameters.

Derivation chain. Every quantity is determined by the Bring's surface geometry. q is fixed by \chi(A) = -6. The nuclear crossing energy quantum is determined by the Skein binding Lagrangian. \alpha and m_e/m_p are determined by the knot spectrum. The molecular crossing energy quantum follows by scale separation. The Alexander polynomial requires no input beyond q.

The factor of 1/2. The threading link resolves the pairwise overshoot exactly: \Delta_{T(2,6)}(q) / 6 \approx 1/2.

Predictions for other even-N rings. The same framework predicts barriers for even-N cyclic molecules. See Table 3. The barrier increases with N, but the threading efficiency ratio is constant for all even N.
